:::{#exr-cross-product-matrix-practice}
#### Computing a cross-product matrix

In R, `crossprod(A, B)` computes the [cross-product matrix](#def-cross-product-matrix) $\tprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}$.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \sbmat{2 \\ 3}.
$$

Compute $\tprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Entry $i$ is the [dot product](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-dot-product) of [column $i$ of](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) $\matr{A}$ with $(2, 3)$.

:::
